# Aftergraph

> Infrastructure and open research for verifiable intelligent systems: bounded missions, scoped authority, durable execution, evidence and independent verification.

## Key pages

- [aftergraph.org](https://aftergraph.org/): Public platform landing page
- [Launcher](https://aftergraph.org/launch): Intent-based launcher for public Aftergraph surfaces
- [Status](https://aftergraph.org/status): Build-time operational snapshot of the public ecosystem
- [Health](https://aftergraph.org/healthz): Deployment health surface
- [Knowledge Plane](https://docs.aftergraph.org/): Developer, standards, evidence and research portal

## Organization

- GitHub organization: [github.com/Aftergraph](https://github.com/Aftergraph)
- Public repositories represented by this surface: intelligence-systems-research, aie, trust-gateway, works-execution, work-intelligence-v2, after-graph-governance, studio, brand, docs, aftergraph.org

This public inventory is an allowlist. Repository visibility is not inferred from naming, local snapshots or historical references.

## Evidence rule

Visibility never upgrades evidence. Research claims, experiments, prototypes and production capabilities remain labelled by maturity. Research evidence is never runtime authority by itself.
